description: This file sets up and runs an AI-powered conversational bot using various speech and language processing services, including speech-to-text, text-to-speech, and large language models, with event handling for client connections.

classes.name: LLMContext
classes.description: Holds the context messages for the language model interaction.

classes.name: LLMContextAggregatorPair
classes.description: Pairs the LLM context with user and assistant aggregators for managing conversation state.

classes.name: Pipeline
classes.description: Defines the sequence of processing steps for the bot.

classes.name: PipelineRunner
classes.description: Manages execution of the pipeline, including handling signals and running tasks.

classes.name: PipelineTask
classes.description: Encapsulates a pipeline instance with parameters and execution controls.

classes.name: OpenAILLMService
classes.description: Large language model service using OpenAI.

classes.name: FastAPIWebsocketParams
classes.description: Parameters for WebSocket transport via FastAPI.

methods.name: run_bot
methods.description: Sets up and runs the conversational bot with specified transport and arguments.

methods.name: bot
methods.description: Main entry point for the bot, initializing transport and starting the bot process.
